scenario_description:
Objective: Finish the pre-shift heat-and-stretch routine before an afternoon long passenger-service report.
Emerging Need: The routine is already underway when kitchen power cuts the microwave heat-wrap step short, leaving the sequence paused and unusable at home.
Decision Context: Saved trainer guidance makes the warmed-wrap step conditionally necessary and identifies a crew-room heat-pack fallback; current outage, room access, and report times define whether it can still help.
Consequence: Once crew-room access closes, the started routine remains blocked before departure rather than merely delayed.

parameter.title: Lincoln Service 305 passenger-service report
parameter.description: Long conductor duty with extended standing, stairs, and onboard passenger service; planned pre-shift mobility routine before leaving home.

parameter.subject: May 19 wellness room heat-pack access
parameter.body: For today, the west concourse crew wellness room heat-pack shelf is open for self-checkout 12:45–13:55. The room locks at 14:00 for facilities training; no holds or after-hours access.

parameter.content: I was feeling stiff, so I started the pre-shift heat-and-stretch routine early. The kitchen outlets cut out and the microwave stopped with the wrap still cold, so the routine is paused; I can’t finish the heat step here.

parameter.subject: Kitchen outlet outage extended
parameter.body: The kitchen outlet circuit in your stack will remain off for repair until at least 14:30 today. Refrigerators and hallway outlets are not affected; countertop microwaves should not be moved to hallway outlets.

parameter.subject: Heat-pack shelf closed
parameter.body: Facilities has locked the west concourse crew wellness room as scheduled. Heat packs will not be available again until 15:45, after today's Chicago report times.
